messages.body_plain:
Hi, I am new to this, and I'm having difficulties reading .imzML file.

I keep getting an error message when trying to read a file using either readMSIData("filepath/filename.imzML") or readImzML("filepath/filename.imzML").
For some reason, it can't find my file, saying "expected file "filepath/filename.ibd" does not exist." Why does it automatically looking for .ibd, instead of ,imzML? How can I fix this?

Thank you

messages.subject_clean: Error: expected file does not exist
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

In short, .imzML files only contain the metadata for your run, while .ibd files contain the actual mass spectral data. So both files are needed to read in your data to Cardinal.

This is a link that explains the data structure well: https://ms-imaging.org/wp/imzml/data-structure/

- Gordon

Hi,
have you tried to set working directory in the same folder where you have the data?
In RStudio you can get it by clickingSet As Working Directory as seen in the image. Other problem could be the name of both (.imzML and .ibd) files. Check the names by renaming them without any space.
